<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1416
Claimant:
Jessica Gordon
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
17 Jul 2024
Claimant reported a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection and said she felt neck and upper back discomfort
within the hour. She is not represented by counsel and confirmed she is willing to speak with me directly.
8 Aug 2024
Reviewed the policy file and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time of
loss. Nothing in the underwriting file suggests the vehicle damage predates the coverage start.
28 Oct 2024
Photos submitted by the claimant show damage to the rear bumper and trunk that is consistent with the impact
described. A few old scratches are visible on the lower panel, which may be older than this crash and will be noted for
the appraiser.
25 Nov 2024
Police report and two drivers' statements place the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision. No independent
witnesses were located, so the account rests on the parties' statements and the physical evidence.
30 Nov 2024
Spoke with the claimant again and she gave the same account of how the collision happened, including speed,
direction, and sequence of events. Her description has not changed across each conversation so far.
8 Jan 2025
Medical records show a back strain, which matches the kind and force of a rear impact of this type. No prior injury to
the same body area is known from her records or from questions asked during intake.
16 Feb 2025
Treatment followed a usual course of physical therapy and tapered off as her symptoms improved, with discharge
notes recording steady progress. Reserves will be reviewed against the current treatment status and final medical
bills.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
